insight: Cloudflare agreed to acquire Replicate in Nov 2025; it keeps operating as a distinct brand, its 50K+ models feeding Cloudflare Workers AI.
name: Replicate
tagline: Run, fine-tune, and deploy thousands of open models via one API.
description: A platform to run open-source models with one API call — image, video, audio, and language — plus fine-tuning and custom deploys with pay-per-second billing. No infra to manage.

modelSupport.notes: Run + fine-tune thousands of community and open-source models.

changelog.summary: Replicate is being acquired by Cloudflare (announced Nov 17, 2025); it continues as a distinct brand, so insight now leads with the acquisition.

edge: Any model is a Cog container behind one API billed per second — the low-commitment way to ship a model you didn't train.
pros: Image, video, audio, and language models
No idle cost, no infra to manage
cons: Per-second cost adds up at scale
Less control than raw GPU rental
